title: Rabbi Tavyomi (a Palestinian Amora)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman mentions him once, in Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot, chapter 2, halakhah 1, folio 12a, asking Rabbi Chizkiyah. Hyman rules out identifying him with Rav Tavyomi, the student of Abaye and Rava, on the grounds that in the latter’s days the academies in the Land of Israel had already been destroyed.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Guggenheimer digital Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:1 paragraph confirms Tavyomi asking Chizkiyah. Hyman’s chronological argument, including his assertion about the destruction of the Palestinian academies, is attributed to him and is not independently established as a historical conclusion here.

The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:1 paragraph explicitly names Rabbi Tavyomi asking Rabbi Chizkiyah. The supplied folio 12a is retained. The once-only observation, distinction from Rav Tavyomi, and argument about the Palestinian academies are Hyman’s historical judgments, not conclusions independently established by this passage.
